---
title: "phibble"
subtitle: "A typed data frame for PHP"
---

phibble is a port of R's tibble to PHP, with the readr-style input and output a
data frame needs. A `DataFrame` holds typed columns, treats `null` as NA, and never
changes in place: every operation returns a new one.

{{< include examples/_tour.md >}}

phibble is the shared table type of a small family of packages for statistics
in PHP. The other packages read and return phibble tables:

- **[phplyr](https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr)** ports dplyr and tidyr as
  pipe-able functions.
- **[phit](https://github.com/phpstats/phit)** is a native
  extension for statistical models and descriptive statistics. It reads model
  data with `DataFrame::toModelData()`.
- **phpolars** is an optional Polars-backed table.
- **cmdstanphp** runs Stan models and will accept phibble data frames.

The packages talk to each other through the `Table` contract. `DataFrame` is the
in-memory implementation. `SqlTable` implements the same contract over a SQL
query, so the verbs compile to SQL and run in the database.

## Install

phibble needs PHP 8.3 or later. PHP 8.5 adds the `|>` pipe operator, which
phibble and phplyr pipelines can use.

```bash
composer require phpstats/phibble
```

phibble has no required dependencies beyond PHP's PDO extension. It works with
Laravel and Doctrine query builders without depending on either.
